authority: Project lead autonomous review under the 2026-09-21 CNY10000 mandate; no independent reviewer.

mechanism.inference: Higher persistent labor-market risk can raise the compensation required for equity exposure after the contemporaneous price decline. The Chinese national unemployment annual contrast is an unvalidated proxy, not the paper's disaster probability.
mechanism.reviewed_locations: PDF pp18-21: Theorems4,6,7; PDF p25 and p60: post-shock response and Figure9
mechanism.critical_condition: A higher equity premium does not by itself imply a higher absolute expected return; Theorem7 adds condition35. The displayed impulse response holds elevated disaster probability fixed.
counterexamples: unemployment can reflect labor supply, participation or productivity rather than priced disaster risk
persistent high unemployment need not mean risk is higher than one year earlier
publication lags and policy responses may eliminate or reverse a monthly relation
mechanism.distinct_from_existing_trials: National labor-force survey numerator/denominator, not household investment preference, fiscal expenditure, ETF prices/volumes or constituent flow; common macro-state and return overlap remain possible.

signal.input: national all-age urban surveyed unemployment rate, in percent; exclude registered, youth, prime-age, 31-city and cumulative-average series
signal.contrast: x_m = u_m - u_(m-12), using the same observation month in the previous year
signal.selection: z=1 if x_m > 0, otherwise z=0; equality is cash
signal.reason: Prior-year same-month comparison is a fixed seasonal reference, not a fitted threshold or an estimated disaster probability.
signal.release_event: Each scheduled NBS national-economy release supplying a new latest observation month; choose the latest observation month if several months appear in one release.
signal.available_from: First exchange session strictly after the latest declared calendar publication date across the authoritative page and its supporting record; no use of same-day timestamps to accelerate entry.
signal.previous_year_value: Earliest retained official value for the exact prior-year month, whose declared publication date precedes the current decision. Conflicts or missing originals stop source qualification; do not use a later backfilled table.
signal.between_events: Carry state until next scheduled eligible release. No synthetic January release, repeated stale monthly decision, extra daily signal or alternative comparator.
signal.missing_or_conflicting_source: Stop qualification for the fixed release universe; do not silently delete intervals or replace missing values with zero.

planned_scope.interval: Open on first session strictly after one scheduled release to open after next scheduled release; non-overlapping release-to-release intervals.
planned_scope.terminal_rule: Only intervals with both endpoints within the fixed date scope; endpoint eligibility determined from publication dates and calendar before price access. Never extend through 2026.
planned_scope.next_source_review: Audit definition lineage and release calendar/version semantics, especially January-February combined releases and 2023 youth-statistic changes; freeze exact URLs and budget before any new source requests.

required_before_any_real_execution: exact source identities, hashes, all release dates and unknown/conflict handling
fixed outcome dividend entitlement definition and price authorities
fixed statistic, dependency-aware uncertainty method, descriptive later segment and sample sufficiency rules
synthetic checks then dedicated one-use registration and atomic claim
later_diagnostic_requirements.later_account_rule: Consecutive selected states should retain holdings where permitted; exact lot, cap-drift, dividends, fills and risk exits must be frozen before an account study. No assumption of free monthly rebalancing.
